claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Carteolol is a hydrophilic beta-adrenergic antagonist that lacks appreciable cytotoxic activity at 2.5 uM; the only reported cell-death effects are nonspecific membrane/mitochondrial toxicity seen at millimolar concentrations in ocular surface cells, so no meaningful killing is expected in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
